event: Back in the cleared chamber, he sits against the wall and tries to draw out the cinder's essence.

Holding the cinder's essence until it stops fighting costs focus

event: The cinder goes dead and grey, and he can feel the room's cold and banked warmth through stone.

changes.note: Ember affinity wakes from the cinder; the counter is as the page holds it, no prose shows it

event: He pushes the heat down the bar, and its tip wakes to a dull ember-orange held by a steady drain.

changes.note: Holding the ember at the bar's tip drains his focus
Ember Channel is learned; rank and level are as the page holds them, no prose shows them

event: The System marks it: SKILL — Ember Channel.
He swells the tip to hard orange and comes up fast, wide round the slow-turning Sentry's back.

memory.fact: Deep water surrounds the Deep Water's submerged platform on three sides.
Deep water surrounds the Deep Water's submerged platform on three sides.
The Drowned Sentry's shell is waterlogged plate rusted fused at every joint over dry rot.

event: He drives the burning tip into its neck seam, and the dry rot inside catches like a struck match.

changes.note: Pushing the bar's tip as hot as it will go costs focus
The full-weight thrust into the Sentry's neck

memory.fact: Iron lit this way lends a searing ember heat to its strikes.
Iron lit this way lends a searing ember heat to its strikes.

event: The water felt the heat: a slick, many-mouthed swarm rises and drags at his calf.
The leeches flinch from the hot iron; he tears free and drives back onto the dry broken walkway.

changes.note: Keeping the bar hot through the escape
Tearing free of the swarm and scrambling out of the water

event: The swarm heaps at the waterline, unable to climb dry stone; across the flood the Sentry burns.
He goes down to the ember chamber, lets the bar cool, and works the shake out of his body.
Rest steadies him, but a deep ache stays in his chest where he pulled the fire in.

changes.note: Rest on the cleared first floor
Rest refills his focus
Rest restores his strength

event: Back on the walkway, he sees the Sentry burned down to a slumped, smoking ruin: finished.

memory.fact: The Drowned Sentry is dead, burned out through its neck-seam.

event: The System marks it: LEVEL UP — 2.

changes.note: The Drowned Sentry's death raises his level
Three attribute points come with the level

event: The swarm has settled back under the flood, and one of the far stair's two seams has parted.
In the quiet chamber below, he sets a point into Vitality and feels his body fill in.

changes.note: One point spent on Vitality
He sets a point into Vitality
The deeper body fills in
The deeper body fills in

event: A second point goes into Might, gathering in his arms; the bar comes up lighter.

changes.note: One point spent on Might
He sets a point into Might
The harder frame holds a little more

event: The last goes into Finesse, sharpening his hands and the balance in his feet.

changes.note: The last point spent on Finesse
He sets a point into Finesse
Quicker, cheaper movement

event: On the walkway he dips the burning bar into the flood, and the cold kills its glow in breaths.

changes.note: Heating a bar the water drinks cold

memory.fact: Cold water quenches the channel fast.
Cold water quenches the channel fast.

event: The swarm slides to the heat and flinches from it: drawn and afraid at once, a handle to use.
He lights the bar's whole top half, the drain wider, and steps down into the flood.

changes.note: Lighting half the bar drains focus faster

memory.fact: Invoking and holding the channel costs focus, and the more metal lit, the greater the drain.
Invoking and holding the channel costs focus, and the more metal lit, the greater the drain.

event: The hot iron cooks a knot of the swarm, but the mass folds round the bar and closes again.
The swarm rises on him and hauls; his foot skids off a slab and the black closes over him.

changes.note: The cold mouths sap and drag him under
Fighting the swarm's pull in the water

memory.fact: The Cistern's water is deep enough to drown in.
The Cistern's water is deep enough to drown in.

event: Drowning, he takes all the heat in his chest at once and shoves it out through his skin.
A point-blank bloom of heat flings the swarm off him, and leaves his chest scoured hollow.

changes.note: The uncontrolled discharge scalds him on the way out
He pours his heat out to the dregs
His arms go heavy after the burst

memory.fact: Ember Burst discharges Ember from the body all at once, in an outward wave of heat.
Ember Burst discharges Ember from the body all at once, in an outward wave of heat.

The pulse sears and flings back whatever is close, and is strongest against a clustered swarm.

An uncontrolled all-out discharge risks backlash on the one releasing it.

event: He hauls out onto the walkway; the swarm re-knits at the waterline and stops there.
Back on the first floor he calms his body and sleeps a heavy, dreamless sleep.

changes.note: A long sleep closes most of the hurt
His heat refills while he sleeps
A long sleep restores his legs

event: He wakes with his heat refilled; only the old ache in his chest has not moved.
He tries to throw his heat outward on purpose, and at first it only leaks down to his hands.
Released rather than pushed, a measured pulse breaks on the rubble in a dark scorch.

From dry ground a hard ring of heat breaks the massed front, and it convulses back into the deep.

changes.note: A large burst takes a deep pull of focus
Baiting and bursting

It is the area counterpart to Ember Channel, releasing the heat into a zone.

A full burst takes a deep pull of focus.

event: The swarm re-gathers slower and smaller; he can bait it and burn it from the dry.
He baits it again and throws the largest ring he has ever thrown, near everything he holds.
The cooked swarm comes apart and does not re-knit; the water lies truly flat and still.

changes.note: The near-total burst sears him
The biggest burst scrapes him hollow
Baiting and bursting again

memory.fact: The Glut is dead, burned apart at the waterline, and the Cistern's water is empty of it.

The Cistern's water can be drunk, though it tastes mineral and foul.

He finds the brazier-stand with dry char and a striker, and four meters of rotted rope.
Through the still water he sees a second iron bar and a river-stone in the silt below the shelf.
He sets the righted brazier-stand, the rope and his finds at the foot of the up-stair.
He dives into the cold and comes up with the second iron bar and the egg-sized river-stone.
